text_block_list.text: Lately, rumors of Biwa Hayahide going on an indefinite hiatus have spread across the racing world. Hearing such talk sends Narita Brian into a rage.
She reflects on her sister's condition up until this point. The thought that Hayahide may never return shakes Narita Brian to her core.
However, when I ask her whether truly believes that's true, she's reminded of her sister's strength and—through tears—chooses to believe in her.
While this is happening, Biwa Hayahide is earnestly devoting herself to her rehabilitation to return to the track, with no thought of giving up in her head.
